lines: In this sad season when tears overflow,
I dream of being held in someone's arms
The feeling that wants to cry can't be put into words
Tonight, too, a cold rain falls
I can't hold it in—nothing but sighs
Even now, summer comes around in this heart
Tell me you love me, every hour of the day
Take me away into your dreams
Unforgettable Heart & Soul
It won't become a voice
Erase the name I wrote in the sand
Where do the waves return to?
Love & Roll, passing on by
Leave love just as it is
Like a sun at a hundred degrees below zero,
a love that dampens the body
The midsummer fruit that makes me dizzy
still blooms in my heart
Even far apart, at twilight
a burning trace of you presses close to my chest
Tell me you love me, every hour of the day
Take me away into your dreams
Unforgettable Heart & Soul
The night can't wait
Erase the name I wrote in the sand
Where do the waves return to?
Love & Roll, passing on by
Leave love just as it is
On a night like this, without letting my tears show,
I want you to tell me we'll meet again
Unforgettable Heart & Soul
O fruit of tears
